Saharanpur Police Mistakenly Honors Owaisi with Guard of Honor

Saharanpur police mistakenly presented a guard of honor, typically reserved for Supreme Court judges, to AIMIM chief Asaduddin Owaisi. The incident led to the removal of the Circle Officer (CO) responsible. The Uttar Pradesh Police have ordered an investigation into the matter. Navbharat Times reported that UP Police sent a letter to X (formerly Twitter) requesting the removal of the post related to the incident, citing the reason for the mistake.
